fatal_blockers: The shell proof exploits an instance-specific degeneracy: 11 bags contain all four global variables, so pairwise marginals become coordinatewise equalities on complete global distributions. For growing formulas, constant-size clause bags will not contain all variables, and the splitter property alone supplies no analogous empty-common-support argument.

Only a one-instance lower bound is established; the exact obstruction minimum, a scalable completeness/soundness ratio, and any composition or recurrence law remain unknown. The differing one-copy ranks 117 and 119 also require explicit legal-baseline accounting before growth can be claimed.
evidence: The verifier's finite shell argument is sound: raw residual square at most two forces the 11 integral full-bag distributions to coincide, empty common legal support forces them to zero, and then 11 normalization rows fail. Together with the universal anchor lower bound, this actually gives objective at least 117+75=192, stronger than the reported exclusion through 181.

The control minimum 119 is exact because every integral anchor term is at least one and the supplied satisfying assignment attains 119 with zero residual. This verifies only the frozen matched control, not general completeness.

STATUS, IDEAS, NOTES, proof_cvp, SOL_RESULT, and verifier output consistently label the result finite and expressly disclaim bag-family scaling, a growing ratio, and a hardness theorem. No finite result is promoted to asymptotic hardness.

The projected G13 cost 6883 and DROP cost 417 are direct witness evaluations, not exhaustive attack classifications or evidence of composition safety. Earlier G32/G37 evidence shows that compatible parity witnesses can remain exactly additive under cross-copy marginal couplings.

The hard-coded family covers the 837 requirements, and HiGHS reports cardinality optimum 12 with zero reported MIP gap. However, the verifier supplies no exact infeasibility certificate for cardinality 11 and does not verify its claimed lexicographic refinement; this provenance issue does not affect the fixed-family shell proof.
